en: Added a quick Create button on the Exams, Tasks and Flashcards pages.
Task and exam details now scroll smoothly and stay easy to read in the detail view.
Startup is faster with the trimmed splash screen and lighter UI animations.
Task and card search now re-render lists with debounced input while typing.

releaseNotes:
## Exam Buddy Pro v2.2.0

Lighter startup, smoother lists and a faster way to create exams, tasks and flashcards.

### What's new
- Quick Create button on the Exams, Tasks and Flashcards pages.
- Task and exam details scroll smoothly in the detail view.
- Lighter startup with the trimmed splash screen and lighter UI animations.
- Task and card search re-render lists with debounced input while typing.

### Improvements
- Smoother focus timer ring updates and session dots.
- Faster tab switching with panel level rendering.
- Faster task list rendering while typing in search.
